derived_by: hand-written (U0.1) from the plan's 'Open routes' decision

before_first_admin.why: creates the first admin, from a loopback peer only (403 setup_local_only otherwise); 410 setup_closed once one exists

always_open.why: liveness probe for load balancers and install.sh; carries no data
curl | sh on a new node has no session
worker join authenticates with the cluster token in the body
the UI must learn whether to show setup or login before it has a session
the way a session is obtained
idempotent; an expired cookie must still be clearable
a browser following OpenAI's redirect carries no session; the attempt's state authorises it
